pages.text: These dread undead bears hunger not only for the flesh of children, but can also crush your enemies with brute force and biting frost. Naturally, creating such a dark spell requires a baby villager offering—the Urbhadhach's favorite prey.
Casting this spell with a Necro Staff allows you to summon more Urbhadhach servants. The Nameless Staff fixes the number of summoned Urbhadhach to 3.
